<!-- pr-reviewer: 635c0c7bc8c187a92cfcd589aedca9a1597b0efd -->
Needs changes before merge.

The source review found no additional code defect. The required heavy tests have no result for this head.

What looks good:

- Both regression tests pass without changes to their assertions.
- The fallback keeps the existing area and crossing checks. It limits the tangent change to `1e-3`.
- The decision record explains the two fixes and the held ring-order change. `Refs #2849` correctly keeps that issue open.
- No golden, fixture, importer, UI, dependency, or process file changes are present. No moved golden needs a line review.

Results locally, against upstream main `6e1805bfdae52fcfea71a946d381dfbfdefc79f5`:

The PR already contains this main. The trial merge needed no additional commit. All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3267`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate build steps | Both passed |
| Motion lib | 516 passed, 10 ignored |
| Motion `xy_arc_entry` | 5 passed |
| App `area_open` | 11 passed |
| App `lead_approach` | 7 passed |
| Clippy, motion and app, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |
| Light lane, both test steps in release | 2 passed |

The light run used `cargo xtask gate light --only "motion light"`. Both selected test steps built and ran. The tests were `the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light` and `wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes_light`.

Extra suites run:

| Crate | Suite | Result |
|---|---|---|
| motion | `corner_arc_radius` | 8 passed |
| motion | `entry_arc` | 12 passed |
| motion | `vertical_arc_entry` | 3 passed |
| app | `recorded_post_streams` | 5 passed |
| app | `shoulder_adaptive` | 7 passed, 2 ignored |
| app | `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| app | `wall_arc_entry` | 7 passed |
| post | `vertical_arc_entry` | 3 passed |

No fixture or importer changes trigger the additional kernel suites.

Safety mutations rerun locally:

1. Restore only `lead_ext.rs` from upstream main. `an_axis_aligned_lead_start_posts_the_users_arc_entry_as_g18_or_g19` fails at `crates/app/tests/lead_approach.rs:133`, with `true vertical arcs now:`. The notes report oblique chords.
2. Restore only `descent_xy.rs` from upstream main. `the_horizontal_arc_entry_on_the_users_pocket_verifies_silent` fails at `crates/app/tests/lead_approach.rs:249`, with `Helix:`. The notes report that the horizontal arc entry does not fit.

Each mutation failed at the expected assertion. After restoration of both PR files, all 7 `lead_approach` tests passed again. No source changes remain.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/descent_xy.rs:97` and the PR body, `Not exercised`: run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. Add their results to the PR body. The current [AGENTS.md, Heavy lanes at review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/6e1805bfdae52fcfea71a946d381dfbfdefc79f5/AGENTS.md#L628-L636) requires these tests before readiness. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects both motion and app heavy lanes. The body says that the release tiers did not run. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. Keep its known-fail checks. This review ran the plan only; the full heavy lanes remain untested. The quick gate and the extra debug suites do not meet this requirement.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
